name: jira-test-case-generator
description: Generate Jira test cases from Confluence and Figma using OpenAI GPT-4o

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run sync:public
scripts.sync:public: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -R frontend/dist/. public/
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w backend && npm run clean -w frontend --if-present && rm -rf public
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w backend && npm run lint:fix -w frontend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w backend && npm run type-check -w frontend
